summary: Esquire Financial Holdings, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on April 30, 2026, announcing a regular quarterly dividend of $0.20 per share on its common stock, payable June 1, 2026 to holders of record May 15, 2026. The filing contains Items 8.01 (Other Events) and 9.01 (Financial Statements and Exhibits) with a press release. This is a routine capital return declaration with no acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change. The board has not made any special-situation recommendation.
